title: Copenhagen, Helsinki and Cityringen gain connected service accounts
summary: Three dated articles connect rail, heating, water and civic services while keeping municipal and regional reporting boundaries visible. Eligible identities reach 75 projects and 43 places; these are not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Fifteen official HTML records inspected November 22. Published opening, adoption, construction, contract and reporting dates remain distinct. Linked documents and dynamic service feeds were not inspected.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
